{{Colored Notice Box|type=style|text='''This page needs improving:''' References to ''discrete versions'', ''old or new versions'', ''old or new systems'', and ''changes between versions'' should not be used ({{rule|T}}) in articles about features in the game. Versions that are explicitly mentioned should instead use the [[Template:Version|version template]]. Text that references changes should simply be removed, unless it is necessary to continue supporting users of an older version in the same namespace. New versions or systems should simply be stated as if they were always there, and old versions or systems should not be mentioned. Read more on the [[Dwarf Fortress Wiki:Community Portal|Community portal]].|bg=#ffe}}<noinclude>

==Usage==
Use this notice at the top of pages that have broken {{rule|T}}. The notice should be removed when the page is corrected, or discussion indicates that the page is free of violations. Timelessness is not a concern in articles in the main space, such as [[Dwarf Fortress]] or [[Caravan arc]].

Add {{tl|Timelessness Notice}} to the top of any offending page.
